positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: What establishes the Pallasine checklist as the settled, authoritative onboarding standard — its mandate now and its supersession of what came before?
positions.why: Both expressions assert the checklist's standing as flat, unhedged fact rather than argued position: src-1 states it as a universal mandate ('Every new hire completes...'), src-2 grounds that mandate historically by noting it replaced the prior wiki page. Read together, they cohere around one directional claim to legitimate authority — a current universal rule backed by a displaced predecessor — which the power and relational reads (legitimate authority-ranking, informational framing) and the shared matter-of-fact register reinforce across both.
